description.value: The study investigated age-related development of affective regulation using emotional fMRI and effective connectivity analyses in children and adults.

spans.text: The current study investigated the brain development of one aspect of hot executive functioning, the regulation of negative affect, from the perspective of affective arousal and effective PFC connectivity.
